claims.quote: Another mouthbrooder type betta originating from South Kalimantan in Indonesia.
This species is known only from the Greater Sunda Islands region in Indonesia.

regions.name: Kalimantan
regions.quote: It's subsequently been recorded over a large range including all four provinces of Kalimantan as well as near Palembang in South Sumatra (Sumatera Selatan) province, Sumatra and the islands of Bangka, Belitung (together forming Bangka-Belitung province) and Bintan (Riau Islands province).
